events.title: 0.60 Update: Seed Information and UI Improvements
events.summary: Patch Notes (0.60)1. Seed Planting RequirementsThe number of seeds required for planting is now also shown in item information.2. Stats Window ImprovementsImproved the Stats window.3. Start Screen Artwork ImprovementsImproved the start screen artwork.

events.title: 0.59 Update: Carpentry Adjustments and Task UI Improvements
events.summary: Patch Notes (0.59)1. Carpentry Unlock Level AdjustmentsMake Storage Space and Wooden Chest now unlock at Carpentry level 10.2. Carpentry Material and XP AdjustmentsChanged the wood materials for both tasks to Maple Plank and Maple Beam, and adjusted their one-time XP rewards to match their unlock level.3. Queue Quantity Button FixFixed an issue where clicking the edge of a queue quantity button (x1/x10/x100/x1000) could activate the adjacent button.4. Clearer One-Time Task Completion StatusImpro

events.title: Update 0.58: Carpentry & Equipment Fixes
events.summary: Patch Notes (0.58)1. Carpentry UpdateComplete Objectives to unlock Carpentry, a new Life Skill.2. Objective Completion SoundAdded a sound effect when an Objective is completed.3. Equipment and Loadout FixesFixed an issue where previously equipped items could turn into different items, be lost, or be duplicated after changing equipment or switching Loadouts.

events.title: Update 0.57: Life Skills, Slot Tickets & Official Wiki
events.summary: Patch Notes (0.57)1. Improved Life Skills level indicatorsThe level display in the top-right corner now sparkles when the current level cap is reached. Selecting it opens that skill's information.2. Updated slot ticket purchase limitsBag Slot Tickets, Loadout Slot Tickets, and Reward Slot Tickets can now only be purchased up to each slot type's maximum capacity.3. Added the official wikiThe official game wiki is now available and can also be opened from the start screen.

events.title: Update 0.56: Bestiary Added
events.summary: Patch Notes (0.56)Writing- Fixed an issue that prevented Reroll from working in Writing.Korean Text- Korean text now wraps at spaces between words.Bestiary- Added the Bestiary.

events.title: Patch Notes (0.55)
events.summary: 1. Fixed an issue where the Yellow Tomato image reverted to a red tomato.2. Inspiration amounts in the Instrument Performance UI now use K/M/B notation.3. Added sources for seeds and some Farming harvests.4. Increased bonus values on some equipment items related to Commerce and Enchanting.5. (PC Demo Only) Added a companion popup window.

events.title: The Iris's Idle Log PC Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello, this is Eary, the developer of Iris's Idle Log.The PC demo of Iris's Idle Log is now available on Steam!This demo lets you try the early part of the game before the full release. If you've already played the mobile version, you can also get a look at how Iris's Idle Log plays on PC.Iris's Idle Log will also be taking part in Steam Next Fest.Throughout Next Fest and after the demo launch, I'll keep going through your feedback and continue refining the PC version, including balance, quality
